G=load(); print(sorted(G))

from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seps=set()
    for i in range(H):
        vals=set(grid[i])
        if len(vals)==1:
            v=vals.pop()
            if any(all(grid[r][j]==v for r in range(H)) for j in range(W)):
                seps.add(v)
    s=seps.pop()
    sepR=[i for i in range(H) if all(x==s for x in grid[i])]
    sepC=[j for j in range(W) if all(grid[i][j]==s for i in range(H))]
    def spans(sep,n):
        sp=[];start=0
        for x in sep: sp.append((start,x-1));start=x+1
        sp.append((start,n-1))
        return [x for x in sp if x[1]>=x[0]]
    rs=spans(sepR,H);cs=spans(sepC,W)
    blocks=[]
    for (a,b) in rs:
        for (c,d) in cs:
            blocks.append((tuple(tuple(row[c:d+1]) for row in grid[a:b+1]),(a,b,c,d)))
    cnt=Counter(b[0] for b in blocks)
    mode=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # choose the block differing from mode (if multiple distinct, pick the minority one)
    cand=[b for b in blocks if b[0]!=mode]
    tile=cand[0][0] if len(cand)==1 or len(set(c[0] for c in cand))==1 else blocks[0][0]

        for i in range(a,b+1):
